document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
You run right into a blast of cosmic cold. You collapse to the 
ground, too stiff to shiver. From the position where you lie, 
you see the many legged creatures with their weird weapons 
scuttling like giant spiders from the bush. Then darkness.
